services.desc: Are you a new member? We are offering a beginner ski lesson on January 3rd, 2026 (Date changed from Jan 11th, 2026) to help you get the most out of our trails. The lessons will be approximately 1.5 hours in duration and will be lead by qualified instructors. The beginner ski lessons are free but are only open to members with a current annual ski membership. We are making some changes to our adult ski program for this season. We have renamed the program to adult ski so that it is clear it is open to everyone who wants to improve and have fun on skis!
